# Lesotho

> [!summary] Data available
> Food data is minimal ([[WorldCuisines]] 3 shared dishes), but [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] has **1,051 ethnobotany records (533 taxa)**, the most of any Sub-Saharan country, almost all from the Guillarmod reference. No FCT; compounds via [[Global]].

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 3 dishes, none Lesotho-only. No other food dataset.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault or `Backlog/`. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) is where a national or regional table would be found. Fallback: [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 37 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: **1,051** ethnobotany records (533 taxa), 1,041 from Guillarmod: charms, potherbs, colic, colds; the potherb records give edible wild greens.
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Lesotho on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Basotho dishes; the ethnobotany is rich but has no food context.
